overview: The National Water Awards (NWA) Innovation Support is a recognition-based scheme under the Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, aimed at promoting innovation in water technology and management. It seeks to identify, encourage, and reward innovative solutions in water conservation, efficiency, and sustainability across sectors. The scheme supports grassroots innovators, startups, and organizations contributing to national water security goals through recognition and visibility.
objectives: Identify and promote innovative practices and technologies in water conservation and management
Encourage grassroots innovation and community-led water security initiatives
Recognize excellence in water use efficiency, reuse, and recycling across industries and sectors
Support scaling of proven water innovations through national visibility and networking
Align with national missions like Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari and Namami Gange for holistic water security
Foster a culture of innovation in the water sector to address challenges of scarcity, pollution, and climate resilience
eligibility: Open to individuals, startups, MSMEs, NGOs, research institutions, and organizations across India that have developed innovative solutions in water conservation, efficiency, reuse, recycling, or management. Projects must demonstrate measurable impact, scalability, and sustainability. Preference is given to grassroots and community-driven innovations aligned with national water missions.
benefits: Recognition through national awards, certificate of appreciation, media coverage, inclusion in Ministry publications, opportunity to showcase innovations at national events like India International Water Week, and networking with policymakers, investors, and sector experts. Awardees may also gain visibility for potential funding, collaboration, and technology adoption by government or private entities.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial support, grants, or subsidies. It is purely recognition-based, offering non-monetary benefits such as awards, certificates, and platform exposure to promote and scale innovative water solutions.
application_process: 1. Visit the National Water Awards portal at https://jalshakti-dowr.gov.in/nwa 2. Review eligibility criteria and innovation categories 3. Prepare a detailed proposal highlighting the innovation, impact, scalability, and sustainability 4. Submit the application online through the portal with required documents 5. Applications are evaluated by a technical committee 6. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for presentation or field verification 7. Final awardees are selected and announced at the National Water Awards ceremony.
required_documents: Detailed project proposal or innovation description
Proof of concept or pilot results
Impact assessment data (water saved, efficiency improved, etc.)
Photographs or videos demonstrating the innovation
References or testimonials from beneficiaries or partners
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year, with awards announced annually around World Water Day (March 22).
implementing_agency: Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
caveats: No financial assistance is provided under this scheme
Recognition does not guarantee future funding or procurement
Awardees must comply with national laws and environmental regulations
The Ministry reserves the right to verify claims and withdraw awards in case of misrepresentation
Innovations must be original and not infringe on intellectual property rights
